turning_mild_steel.finish: Carbide insert DCMT 070204 grade P10 — cutting speed 150-200 m/min

turning_alloy_steel.rough: Carbide insert CNMG 432 grade P25 coated — cutting speed 60-90 m/min
turning_alloy_steel.finish: Carbide insert DCMT 070204 grade P10 — cutting speed 100-150 m/min

turning_cast_iron.rough: Carbide insert CNMG 432 grade K20 — cutting speed 70-100 m/min

turning_aluminium.rough: Carbide insert CCMT grade K10 uncoated — cutting speed 200-400 m/min
turning_aluminium.finish: PCD tipped insert VCMT — cutting speed 300-500 m/min

milling_steel.finish: Carbide end mill 4-flute TiAlN coated — cutting speed 80-120 m/min

milling_aluminium.rough: Carbide end mill 3-flute uncoated polished — cutting speed 200-400 m/min
milling_aluminium.finish: Carbide end mill 3-flute uncoated polished — cutting speed 300-500 m/min

grinding_mild_steel.tool: Aluminium oxide wheel A60 K5 V — wheel speed 30-35 m/s

tapping_steel.tool: HSS tap with cutting oil — speed 5-10 m/min

sequencing_rules.rule: Facing and centering is always the first operation to establish datum surfaces
sequencing_rules.source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1 — Process Planning

sequencing_rules.rule: All rough operations before semi-finish operations — remove bulk material first
All semi-finish operations before finish operations
Centre drilling must precede twist drilling on a lathe to prevent drill wandering
Drilling must precede boring — boring improves the hole left by drilling
Boring must precede reaming — reaming removes only 0.1-0.3mm stock
Internal features (bores, holes, pockets) before external finishing operations
Keyway milling after the cylinder it sits on is finish-turned
O-ring groove turning after finish turning of that diameter
Thread cutting after the OD or bore it's on is at finished size
Grinding is always the last size-controlling operation for that feature
Chamfering and deburring are always the final operations

h6.note: Grinding mandatory — turning alone cannot achieve IT6

H7.note: Reaming after drilling, or fine boring — standard bearing fit

H8.note: Fine turning acceptable — general sliding fit

IT9.note: Standard turning or milling sufficient — general purpose

Ra_1_6.note: Fine finish — for bearing seats and sealing surfaces
